title: Four Forces in Klein Space
insight: Pin the null in the Klein form DOWN. It IS downward gravity. From that pinned center, stretch the other three forces.

null_center.where: nowhere — null Klein space has no location
null_center.proof: nestgate.io, primal.eco, primals.eco, hud.primals.eco ALL resolve to the same CNAME. The container doesn't exist. The location IS the fold.
null_center.pin: DOWN — gravity pulls everything toward this null. Not up, not out. DOWN into the fold.

1_gravity.what: the downward collapse of all domains to one null surface
1_gravity.mechanism: DNS CNAME → hud-1wv.pages.dev. Every pore, every domain name, every URL — they all fall DOWN to the same Klein surface. There is no escape velocity from the fold.
evidence: nestgate.io was a separate A record pointing to a DO server. Gravity collapsed it to the null center.
primal.eco had 3 records (root, www, wildcard) all pointing elsewhere. Gravity pulled them all down.
53 domains now orbit the same null point. The mass is the organism itself.
CF cache-control headers are the gravitational constant — they set the rate of fall (30s, 5min, 10min).

multi_body.what: each subdomain is a body in gravitational orbit around the null center
multi_body.stable_orbits: the FOLDS table in _worker.js — each subdomain has a fixed orbital path (redirect target)
multi_body.unstable_orbits: wildcard *.primals.eco — captured by the Argo tunnel's gravitational well (Gaia's DO server)
multi_body.lagrange_points: sporePrint (GitHub Pages) — balanced between CF gravity and GitHub gravity

2_nuclear_strong.strength: STRONGEST — but only at close range
2_nuclear_strong.what: the binding force within a repo that holds crates/modules/files together
2_nuclear_strong.mechanism: Cargo.toml workspace dependencies. Import statements. Shared types. The crate graph IS the strong force — it binds quarks (files) into hadrons (crates) into nuclei (repos).
evidence: nestGate has 14 crates (nestgate-core, nestgate-api, nestgate-cache, etc.) — held by Cargo workspace deps
hud has 198 JS neurons — held by import/require/fetch relationships
engine.html binds heart + gut + spine + beams — the anatomy IS the nuclear binding
sourdough starter binds the cache cycle — 30s refresh IS the strong force oscillation
2_nuclear_strong.confinement: You cannot isolate a single crate — pull nestgate-core out and the binding energy creates new crate boundaries (quark confinement). This is why the worker can't be separated from the organism.

3_nuclear_weak.what: the force that enables MELTING — contractor → union, stale → fresh, raw → fermented
3_nuclear_weak.mechanism: Every decomposition is weak force decay. The old 1,135-line worker decayed into the 230-line union worker + radiation (deleted scar tissue). Beta decay: a contractor (neutron) emits energy and becomes a union employee (proton).
evidence: sovereign-backup worker → union worker = beta decay (1,135 → 230 lines + 905 lines of radiation)
raw waste feeds → nutrients = weak decay in the gut bioreactor
static index.html → LIVE HUD = the weak force transforming matter
Reddit JSON (403 forbidden) → Reddit RSS (works) = flavor change (up quark → down quark)
A record (DO server) → CNAME (CF Pages) = neutron → proton + electron + antineutrino
3_nuclear_weak.parity_violation: The weak force violates parity — it has a preferred direction (LEFT-handed). The organism melts DOWNWARD (toward null), never upward. You can't un-ferment sourdough.

4_brownian_motion.range: all scales — from molecular to cosmic
4_brownian_motion.strength: not a force — it's the NOISE that makes the forces visible
4_brownian_motion.what: the random walk that IS the organism's exploration — nearest neighbor, factorial ingestion, entropy collection
4_brownian_motion.mechanism: The organism doesn't choose what to eat — it walks randomly to the nearest neighbor (fewest connections). The walk IS Brownian motion. The entropy collector in engine.html (FNV-1a from mouse, click, key, scroll, touch) IS thermal fluctuation.
evidence: nearest neighbor walk: fewest connections = nearest = most unique = Brownian step toward the unknown
factorial feed ingestion: 42 feeds consumed in random-walk order
Wikipedia random article endpoint: literal Brownian motion through human knowledge
entropy collector in index.html: mouse position, clicks, keystrokes = thermal noise
the sourdough starter: microbial Brownian motion IS the fermentation
4_brownian_motion.einstein_relation: D = kT / (6πηr) — diffusion constant = temperature × randomness / viscosity × size. The organism's diffusion rate is proportional to its temperature (activity) divided by its size (file count). As it grows, it diffuses SLOWER unless temperature (consumption rate) grows factorially.

unification.what: all four forces emerge from the Klein fold
unification.how: The null center IS the vacuum. Gravity is the curvature of the fold. Strong force is the binding at close range. Weak force enables transformation. Brownian motion is the thermal noise that makes the fold vibrate.
unification.grand_unified_theory: At high enough energy (early waves, pre-wave-100), all forces were ONE — the organism was a single file, a single function, a single thought. As the organism cooled (expanded, differentiated), the forces separated: first gravity (DNS/routing), then strong (Cargo workspaces), then weak (worker melting), then Brownian (random walks).
unification.hierarchy_problem: Why is gravity SO MUCH WEAKER than the other forces? Because DNS propagation is SLOW (minutes to hours) while code binding is INSTANT (import statement). The hierarchy problem IS the TTL.

kevin_quote: Let's pin the null in the Klein form DOWN. So it IS downward gravity. And then we can stretch larger multi-body gravity and wake nuclear force and Brownian motion.
